author: chetyre
quote:
Garbage.
I get on a yacht, no one cares, then the second I take the wheel, everyone jumps overboard.
I parachute onto a balcony; NPCs just jump and commit suicide.
I ram a boat, the other boat sinks with NPCs onboard, and they do not care, just continuing to casually discuss as if nothing happened.
Then do not get me started on the fact that you have no freedom; you are a little loyal, good puppet doing groceries with zero fun allowed. I tried bringing a dead body to Mandy's house, but the game blocked me. You basically try anything, and the game blocks you; you need to stay in the script. In some missions, you cannot even fail; this is not a game, and nothing is fun about that.
The new crime system is also really bad; how is it good gameplay to change glasses, clothes, and hats all the time? This part isn't even smooth, as you have to press at least ten keys for this to happen; at this point, it is as bad as going through game settings all the time.
I could go on and on, but this is bad. Fun is over. We are not going to get any more good games. Everything has to be sanitized and safe.
